name: The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated
summary: The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in electricity, heat supply, telecommunication, and gas supply in Japan. It operates through four segments: Energy Business; Power Transmission and Distribution Business; Information and Communication Business; and Lifestyle and Business Solution Business. The company generates power from thermal, hydropower, wind, biomass, and nuclear power generation plants.
